facts.claim_en: In Alabama's latest report to the U.S. Department of Education, 2,340 children served in early intervention (IDEA Part C) were referred for preschool special education (Part B) eligibility.
facts.claim_es: En el informe más reciente de Alabama al Departamento de Educación de EE. UU., 2,340 niños atendidos en intervención temprana (Parte C de IDEA) fueron referidos para determinar si califican para educación especial preescolar (Parte B).
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, Alabama IDEA Part B State Performance Plan/Annual Performance Report (FFY 2024)
facts.quote: a. Number of children who have been served in Part C and referred to Part B for Part B eligibility determination. 2,340

facts.claim_en: 1,539 of the children found eligible in Alabama had an IEP developed and in place by their third birthday.
facts.claim_es: 1,539 de los niños que calificaron en Alabama tenían un IEP preparado y en marcha para su tercer cumpleaños.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, Alabama IDEA Part B State Performance Plan/Annual Performance Report (FFY 2024)
facts.quote: c. Number of those found eligible who have an IEP developed and implemented by their third birthdays. 1,539

facts.claim_en: 49 children in Alabama were referred to early intervention less than 90 days before their third birthday.
facts.claim_es: 49 niños en Alabama fueron referidos a intervención temprana menos de 90 días antes de su tercer cumpleaños.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, Alabama IDEA Part B State Performance Plan/Annual Performance Report (FFY 2024)
facts.quote: e. Number of children who were referred to Part C less than 90 days before their third birthdays. 49

facts.claim_en: Alabama reported 99.87% of eligible children referred from early intervention had an IEP by their third birthday (1,539 of 1,541).
facts.claim_es: Alabama informó que el 99.87% de los niños que calificaron y venían de intervención temprana tenían un IEP para su tercer cumpleaños (1,539 de 1,541).
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, Alabama IDEA Part B State Performance Plan/Annual Performance Report (FFY 2024)
facts.quote: Percent of children referred by Part C prior to age 3 who are found eligible for Part B, and who have an IEP developed and implemented by their third birthdays. 1,539 1,541 99.06% 100% 99.87%
